In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
electronic reverse auctions are a very powerful tool for sourcing, which can be used to improve the buying organization's financial, operational, and strategic position.

the relationship between price savings and relationship quality is moderated by supplier-related factors, and that the impact of the buyer’s organizational antecedents is dependent on the supplier’s strategic orientation.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the impact of e-sourcing on the buyer-suppliers relationship and the price savings is not as straightforward as it has been portrayed in the literature.
the impact of electronic sourcing is not only dependent on the buying organization’s actions but also on supplier-related factors.

electronic reverse auctions can be a powerful strategic tool for buying firms, but that their use requires careful consideration of the organizational and project antecedents, as well as of the supplier-related moderators.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the buying firm's organizational and project characteristics, as well as supplier-related factors, are key determinants of the impact of e-sourcing on outcomes.

buying organizations need to consider a broad set and a variety of e-sourcing outcomes when designing electronic reverse auctions and that they can use a number of antecedents to impact these outcomes.
buying organizations can influence the impact of electronic sourcing initiatives on the buyer-supplyer relationship and other outcomes by taking into account a broader set of antecedents.
